scores.evidence: Any service beyond the Phase 0 skeleton | V2 (CI has no direct production credentials; unsigned images rejected)
scores.rationale: Explicit dependency map and validation gates (V1, V2, V3, V4, V5) ensure each phase is proven before dependents are specified or exposed.

scores.evidence: a one-line change to one low-criticality internal service reaches production, and its `/health` endpoint returns the new version string.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production path with deploy, trace, alert and rollback before any feature work.

scores.evidence: OIDC-federated short-lived credentials; CI only pushes signed images... Flip condition: V2 fails, or the runtime can't enforce admission policy
scores.rationale: The gates table gives reversibility, default, assumption, validation and flip condition for each irreversible decision, and it lists the missing inputs.

scores.evidence: Tasks, widest rework first: 1. Service manifest schema and template v1 (V1). 2. OIDC federation
scores.rationale: Phase 1 is ordered widest first, waves go lowest criticality first, and trust and contract work comes before onboarding.

scores.evidence: 0 | OIDC for the skeleton; branch protection
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security work in every phase from 0 to 5.

scores.evidence: OpenTelemetry traces span the CI job through to the pod, and an alert fires on failed sync or failed deploy.
scores.rationale: Observability is built in Phase 0 and each later phase has concrete items.
Each phase names reproducibility measures, including versioned templates, SBOMs, hermetic builds and a restore runbook.
Every phase has rollback or failure handling, including the break-glass drill, the legacy fallback and canary auto-rollback.
The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Remote build cache (e.g. Bazel): pulled forward if V3 shows build time p90 above 10 minutes.
scores.rationale: Five deferred items each carry a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: The plan is strong and covers all 10 dimensions with concrete content. Its weak points are small: the threaded concerns are terse table cells, and some thresholds are assumptions.
